t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Depending on the color of the gnome, they lead to either a dark or a bright forest. The aim is to try to memorize which color gnomes lead to which forest and which forest has the most mushrooms at the time (which can fluctuate).

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes appear in fixed pairs: orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow, and blue and purple. Four of the gnomes lead to a forest with a yellow basket (the brown, pink, yellow and purple gnomes), while the remaining four gnomes lead to a forest with a red basket (the orange, green, red and blue gnomes). One of the forests has more mushrooms, but this can change during the game (sometimes the forest with the yellow basket has more mushrooms, while sometimes the one with the red basket). If the mushrooms are consistently low in one forest, it is worth checking out the other one and keep selecting the gnomes that lead to the "correct" forest with more mushrooms (although this changes during the game, so one has to concentrate and remember which forest works better at the moment).
